patches.diff:
--- a/level/tuning.tres
+++ b/level/tuning.tres
@@ -4,7 +4,7 @@
 
 [resource]
 script = ExtResource("1_tuning")
-ledge_gap_width = 6.6
+ledge_gap_width = 4.0
 ledge_bypass_deaths = 5
 marker_color = Color(0.816, 0.486, 0.337, 1)
 marker_emission = 0.0
patches.rationale: Four fall deaths falling just short show the gap is too wide, so the narrower width restores a comfortable margin.
patches.summary: narrow ledge gap that caused repeated falls

patches.diff:
--- a/level/tuning.tres
+++ b/level/tuning.tres
@@ -6,8 +6,8 @@
 script = ExtResource("1_tuning")
 ledge_gap_width = 6.6
 ledge_bypass_deaths = 5
-marker_color = Color(0.816, 0.486, 0.337, 1)
-marker_emission = 0.0
+marker_color = Color(0.2, 0.85, 1, 1)
+marker_emission = 2.0
 switch_prompt_text = "Find a way through."
 enemy_aggro_delay = 0.0
 fork_arrow_points_to = "left"
patches.rationale: The player wandered the plaza for almost ninety seconds because the beacon matched the wall, so a cyan emissive marker restores contrast.
patches.summary: make plaza beacon contrasting and emissive

patches.diff:
--- a/level/tuning.tres
+++ b/level/tuning.tres
@@ -8,7 +8,7 @@
 ledge_bypass_deaths = 5
 marker_color = Color(0.816, 0.486, 0.337, 1)
 marker_emission = 0.0
-switch_prompt_text = "Find a way through."
+switch_prompt_text = "Press the red switch on the balcony."
 enemy_aggro_delay = 0.0
 fork_arrow_points_to = "left"
 corridor_segments = 12
patches.rationale: The player bumped the closed gate three times on vague text, so naming the red balcony switch directs them.
patches.summary: name red balcony switch in hall objective

patches.diff:
--- a/level/tuning.tres
+++ b/level/tuning.tres
@@ -9,6 +9,6 @@
 marker_color = Color(0.816, 0.486, 0.337, 1)
 marker_emission = 0.0
 switch_prompt_text = "Find a way through."
-enemy_aggro_delay = 0.0
+enemy_aggro_delay = 2.5
 fork_arrow_points_to = "left"
 corridor_segments = 12
patches.rationale: Both deaths came almost immediately after landing with zero delay, so a longer delay gives time to see and react.
patches.summary: delay enemy charge after drop landing

patches.diff:
--- a/level/tuning.tres
+++ b/level/tuning.tres
@@ -10,5 +10,5 @@
 marker_emission = 0.0
 switch_prompt_text = "Find a way through."
 enemy_aggro_delay = 0.0
-fork_arrow_points_to = "left"
+fork_arrow_points_to = "right"

patches.rationale: The arrow pointing left sent the player to the dead end, so pointing right matches the true exit.
patches.summary: point exit sign to right branch
